summary: Frontend-only testing of the 'Télécharger Jokoo' smart download button on the Next.js marketing site (localhost:3001). Platform detection via User-Agent works correctly on all 4 buttons (hero-download-btn, header-download-btn, store-ios-btn, store-android-btn). iPhone UA shows the App Store fallback toast, Android UA shows the APK 'bientôt disponible' toast (env vars empty as expected), desktop scrolls to #download section without a toast. Toast auto-dismisses after 5 seconds. No console/page errors. Regression pages /legal, /blog, /prestataires, /contact, /apropos all return 200 and render main content. /legal correctly loads legal documents (Conditions, Confidentialité, Cookies, Mentions légales, ...).
critical_code_review_comments: DownloadButton.tsx: platform detection is robust (handles iPadOS-as-Mac via ontouchend). No changes needed.
iOS toast text 'Disponible prochainement sur l'App Store 🍎' and Android toast 'L'APK Android sera bientôt disponible ici. Merci de votre patience 🤖' both match expectations.

StoreButtons: both store-ios-btn and store-android-btn correctly route through the same platform-aware handleDownload (so tapping the Google Play button on an iPhone still shows the App Store toast — intentional behavior per spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js marketing site is served on port 3001 (NOT the Expo app on 3000). To test platform detection use page.add_init_script to override navigator.userAgent (setting extra HTTP headers alone is not sufficient because detectPlatform() reads navigator.userAgent client-side). Test IDs available: hero-download-btn, header-download-btn, store-ios-btn, store-android-btn, download-toast.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug reproduced. All 4 buttons behave as specified: iPhone UA → App Store toast; Android UA (empty APK URL) → 'bientôt disponible' toast; Desktop → smooth scroll to #download. Toast auto-dismisses after 5s. No JS console errors during any interaction.
